title: Bhai Buddha Singh Brings the Khalsa Near the Battlefield

blocks.text: The Khalsa now advances under Bhai Buddha Singh with deliberate caution. He refuses to rush blindly toward the enemy, warning that they must not put up a camp in close vicinity lest the Pathans scatter or prepare too well for the attack.

Meanwhile Ala Singh holds out under strain, counting on the promised arrival and trying to steady his own following until help appears. By dawn the Khalsa has maneuvered close enough to judge the field properly and the impending clash becomes unavoidable.
The page is about disciplined preparation rather than battlefield spectacle. Its tension lies in timing, distance, and the nerve required to wait for the right moment.
